messages:
olivia: quick thought: split admission -> coalescer with a tiny "cleanroom" handoff. pros: decouples logic. cons: copies or GC risk.
ben: copy-handoff is safe for SLA tenants. pointer-handoff saves ~2-4ms p50 but can spike tails during GC.
maya: what about a 3-way handshake (reserve->fill->commit)? small protocol cost, deterministic ownership, clearer backpressure signals.
olivia: handshake sounds attractive. also per-tenant default: copy for SLA, pointer-opt-in for best-effort. feature-flag gated.
ben: for pointer mode we need epoch-based reclamation or cheap refcounts to avoid mid-run frees. epoch seems lower overhead.
infra-bot: deploy: feature-flag batch.cleanroom -> staging :rocket:
maya: observability: emit low-cardinality events: batch.handoff {id,kind,hold_ms,sla_bucket} to stitch traces.
olivia: action: maya draft addendum for RFC (handoff kinds, lifecycle epoch, tracing tags). ben will bench pointer+epoch in staging.
ben: will run microbench and post numbers by EOD.
maya: cool. keeping defaults conservative to protect p99.
